rows.grounds: compound indicating the totality of deities
compound denoting disciplined devotion as a practice
locative adverb referring to the present context
states the ground or justification for the prescribed practice

items.question: Why must disciplined devotion to all deities be undertaken in this context?
premises: Certain ritual practices are prohibited by authoritative scriptural statements.
A valid devotional practice must be established in their place.
Disciplined devotion directed to all deities provides the required justification.
items.inference: Therefore disciplined devotion to all deities should be performed here.
items.plain_english: For this reason, the practice of devotion to all the gods should be undertaken here.
